hero.caption: Cyclone Ada (1970) track. Uses the color scheme from the Saffir-Simpson Hurricane Scale. The points show the location of each storm at six-hour intervals. The colour represents the storm's maximum sustained wind speeds as classified in the Saffir-Simpson Hurricane Scale (see below), and the shape of the data points represent the nature of the storm.
